tasks.title: Switch PWA to prompt flow and add SKIP_WAITING message contract
acceptance_criteria: vite.config.ts VitePWA registerType is 'prompt' (injectManifest strategy and sw.ts filename unchanged)
src/sw.ts no longer calls skipWaiting() at module top level; clientsClaim() is retained
src/sw.ts message listener handles { type: 'SKIP_WAITING' } by calling self.skipWaiting(), alongside the existing CHECK_REMINDERS branch
src/vite-env.d.ts references vite-plugin-pwa/react client types so virtual:pwa-register/react type-checks
tests: the sw message handler calls skipWaiting when it receives a SKIP_WAITING message and not for unrelated message types

tasks.title: Add update-available toast component and i18n strings
acceptance_criteria: update-prompt.tsx uses useRegisterSW from virtual:pwa-register/react and renders nothing when needRefresh is false
when needRefresh is true it renders a non-auto-dismissing toast with title t('update.title') and a button t('update.reload')
clicking the reload button calls updateServiceWorker(true)
en.json and fr.json each have an update section with title and reload strings
tests: update-prompt renders nothing when needRefresh is false
update-prompt renders the title and reload button when needRefresh is true
clicking reload calls updateServiceWorker with true
update.title and update.reload exist in both en and fr locales

tasks.title: Mount UpdatePrompt in the app shell
acceptance_criteria: UpdatePrompt is rendered once inside App so it is always mounted regardless of route
the app registers exactly one service worker (no double registration; notification service's serviceWorker.ready still resolves)

out_of_scope: Periodic background update polling or manual check-for-updates button
